JSW Steel eyes West Asia demand, flags import risks

JSW Steel anticipates increased demand from reconstruction efforts in West Asia. However, the company has also cautioned that surplus steel from countries like China, Japan, and Russia might be diverted to the Indian market. This potential influx of imports poses a risk to domestic steel producers.
